newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Fifth Zambian bank placed under receivership.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Zambian bank placed under receivership.

text.p: Zambia's troubled Exim Bank has been put into receivership to facilitate its restructuring, the central bank said on Friday.
"The main reason for putting Exim Bank under receivership is...to enable it to concentrate on its core business of trade finance," a central bank official said.
"The possibility of selling the bank is also being looked into very seriously," the official added.
The spokesman said the central bank would pay all recorded outstanding deposits in full.

Exim Bank becomes the fifth bank in Zambia to be placed under receivership after Meridien BIAO Bank Zambia Ltd, Commerce Bank, African Commercial Bank and Cooperative Bank all collapsed between May and November in 1995 following liquidity problems.
There are a total of 19 operating banks in Zambia. -- Lusaka newsroom +2601 222 689
